renewals.notes: Texas LLCs file annual franchise tax and public information report filings with the Comptroller, not an annual report with the Secretary of State. The annual franchise tax report is due May 15; taxable entities at or below the no-tax-due threshold still file the required information report.

filingFacts.llcFeeNotes: Certificate of Formation for a Texas LLC. Texas SOS Form 205 instructions list a $300 filing fee.
filingFacts.nameReservationNotes: An entity name may be reserved for 120 days on Form 501, and a reservation may be renewed by filing a new application during the 30 days before it expires. The filing fee is $40 for both the application and the renewal. The figure shown is the credit card total of $41.08, because the Secretary of State adds a statutorily authorized convenience fee of 2.7 percent of the total fees to card payments. Paying by personal check or money order keeps the cost at $40.
